effects_kit: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent source kit of SMALL restrained pixel-art game effects for existing cozy ranch actions. Arrange EXACTLY nine isolated motifs on a 3x3 grid with ample transparent gutters, not a full scene. Row1: small warmtan dust puff; three brown wood chips flying gently; small warmgray stone powder puff. Row2: small soft golden construction-complete glint; compact warmcream angular physical-hit spark without blood; subdued russet brief hurt-impact spark. Row3: a tiny creamgold item-collection sparkle; three short palecream curved sound wave arcs radiating right for whistle or bark; a small broken brass lock body with two falling metal fragments. No labels/text/numbers/HP bars, no characters/animals/weapons/selection circles, no full screen flash, no magical fire. Each motif should be legible at16 to24 logical pixels and occupy at most one game cell; large transparent margin. Flat2-3colors per motif, crisp logical pixels enlarged nearestneighbor, same muted earthy farm palette, darkbrown only where needed, no gradients/glow/blur/smooth vector strokes. Actual RGBA transparency outside discrete pixel shapes. These originals will be separated and animated as minimal short game sprites, so keep each motif compact and unique without background or frame.
